headline: New housing protests in Spain: dates, cities and route of the demonstrations
summary: More than twenty Spanish cities are preparing demonstrations over housing. The protests are part of a wider push on housing costs in Spain.
why: Housing policy in Spain affects residential property developers, landlords, and the banks that finance mortgages. Protests can prompt government rent and tenancy measures.
